localhost:8081/sku_system.php - SKU List Viewer (REST-like endpoint) - 200 OK
localhost:8081/sku_search.php - SKU Search Interface (POST form) - 200 OK
localhost:8081/sku_add.php - SKU Add/Create Function (POST form with DB operations) - 200 OK
localhost:8081/sku_url.php - SKU URL Model Processing (SSRF potential, IP leakage) - 200 OK

targets.objective: Test for SQL injection, NoSQL injection, command injection, and authentication bypass in search parameter. Test both GET and POST methods.
targets.rationale: Search functionality typically vulnerable to injection attacks. User input directly processes database queries without apparent sanitization.

targets.objective: Test for SQL injection, authentication bypass, authorization flaws, CSRF, and data validation bypass. Test form submission with malicious payloads.
targets.rationale: Database insertion endpoint with information disclosure vulnerability (file path leakage). Accepts multiple parameters without validated CSRF token. Directly interacts with SQLite database.

targets.objective: Test for SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery), XXE, URL manipulation, Local File Inclusion (LFI), and arbitrary file read attacks via URL parameter.
targets.rationale: CRITICAL: Accepts URL parameter for external API calls. References unreachable API at 127.0.0.1:4455 suggesting potential SSRF attack vector. Could be used to access internal services or perform port scanning.

targets.objective: Test for business logic flaws, IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference), unauthorized access, and data disclosure in table operations.
targets.rationale: Displays SKU table with ID, Details, and Actions columns. May support parameters for filtering/pagination that could be exploited for IDOR attacks or data enumeration.

targets.objective: Test for template injection (Twig), authentication bypass, session hijacking, and general web application vulnerabilities. Verify CSRF token presence/absence.
targets.rationale: Main application entry point. Twig template engine v3.22.1 in use - susceptible to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) if user input is rendered in templates. Each request generates new session ID.

targets.objective: Analyze for dependency vulnerabilities, version-specific exploits, and supply chain attacks. Cross-reference versions against known CVE databases.
targets.rationale: Exposed dependency file reveals exact package versions (Twig ^3.20). Attackers can identify known vulnerabilities affecting these specific versions and craft targeted exploits.

targets.objective: Analyze Docker configuration for security misconfigurations, default credentials, and infrastructure vulnerabilities. Verify privilege escalation possibilities.
targets.rationale: CRITICAL: Dockerfile is publicly accessible revealing complete infrastructure setup. Shows user switching (appuser -> root -> www-data), SQLite database location (/var/db), and base image information enabling targeted attacks.

targets.objective: Enumerate vendor directory contents, identify library versions, and test for information disclosure or path traversal attacks.
targets.rationale: Publicly accessible vendor directory exposes library paths and potentially sensitive code. Could enable library-specific exploit targeting known vulnerabilities in exposed packages.

keyFindings: [CRITICAL] Dockerfile publicly exposed - reveals full infrastructure: PHP 8.1-Apache, SQLite database, user privilege configuration, and Docker build process
[CRITICAL] sku_url.php endpoint leaks internal information: client IP (172.18.0.1) and internal API endpoint (127.0.0.1:4455). Potential SSRF vulnerability via URL parameter.
[CRITICAL] Potential SSRF vulnerability in sku_url.php - accepts user-controlled URL for external API calls, could enable internal network scanning or exploitation
[HIGH] composer.json and composer.lock publicly accessible - reveals exact PHP dependency versions (Twig 3.20+, Symfony components) enabling version-specific vulnerability exploitation
[HIGH] sku_search.php and sku_add.php appear vulnerable to SQL injection - user input processed directly without apparent input sanitization or parameterized queries
[HIGH] sku_add.php reveals file path disclosure vulnerability - PHP errors expose /var/www/html/sku_add.php:11 and database schema details (SQLite constraints)
[HIGH] Database interactions trigger verbose error messages - 'SQLSTATE[23000]' and table schema details revealed (skus.sku NOT NULL constraint)
[HIGH] Composer vendor directory publicly accessible - vendor/autoload.php returns HTTP 200, exposing library paths and enabling dependency enumeration
[MEDIUM] No CSRF tokens observed on forms - sku_add.php and sku_search.php POST forms may be vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery attacks
[MEDIUM] Apache VirtualHost configuration file publicly accessible - wwwconf/app_conf.conf reveals server setup, DocumentRoot, and logging configuration
[MEDIUM] Session IDs generated but appear to be random strings sent in page content - potential session management issues or session fixation vulnerabilities
[MEDIUM] .htaccess file returns 403 Forbidden - indicates file exists but is protected (may contain security directives worth bypassing)
[MEDIUM] Application runs in 'Sandbox mode: Enabled' - unclear what restrictions this imposes; may be bypassable
[LOW] Multiple static files (main.js, script.js, app.js, test.php) return 404 - no client-side JavaScript found for AJAX analysis, but Twig SSTI still possible
